---
title: "DS2_clean_proj"
author: "Austin Lehman"
format: html
editor: visual
---

clean_countries variable description

country - Name of the country 

inflation - The annual percentage change in the Consumer Price Index in 2024 

gdp_capita - 2024 GDP per capita, adjusted for purchasing-power difference

pop - The 2023 population in millions from each country as of 2023, sourced form the UN 

per_chg_pop - The percent change in population from 2022 to 2023

region - The continent that contains each nation

subregion - UN defined subregion assigned to each nation

```{r}
#install.packages("tidymodels")
library("tidymodels")
#install.packages("rvest")
library("rvest")
library("stringr")

##read html for wiki data 
wiki<-read_html("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_population_(United_Nations)")%>%
  html_elements("table")%>%
  html_table()

contries_df<-wiki[[1]]%>%rename("country" = 'Country or territory', 
                                "pop_2023" = `Population(1 July 2023)`,
                                "region" = "UN continentalregion[1]",
                                "subregion" = "UN statisticalsubregion[1]",
                                "per_chg_pop" = `Change(%)`)

global_inflation<-read_html("https://globalstats.info/economy/inflation/")%>%
  html_elements("table")%>%
  html_table()
inflation_df<-global_inflation[[1]]%>%
  rename("country" = "Country", "inflation" = "Inflation Rate (%)")

global_GDP_capita<-read_html("https://globalstats.info/economy/richest-countries/")%>%
  html_elements("table")%>%
  html_table()
GDP_capita_df<-global_GDP_capita[[1]]%>% rename("country" = "Country/Region", "gdp_capita" = "GDP per capita (USD, PPP)")

##################
##cleaning
##################

contries_df<- contries_df%>%
  select("country", "pop_2023", "per_chg_pop", "region", "subregion")%>%
  mutate(Country = str_extract(string = country, pattern ="[^\\[]+"))%>%
  mutate(region = if_else(subregion == "South America", subregion, region))%>%
  mutate(region = if_else(subregion == "Caribbean", "North America", region))%>%
  mutate(region = if_else(subregion == "Central America", "North America", region))%>%
  mutate(region = if_else(subregion == "Northern America", "North America", region))

GDP_capita_df<-GDP_capita_df%>%
  mutate(country = str_replace(country, "Congo, D.+", replacement = "DRC"))%>%
  mutate(country = str_extract(string = country, pattern ="[^\\(|,|*]+"))%>%
  mutate(country = str_replace(country, "Hong Kong SAR", replacement = "Hong Kong"))%>%
  mutate(country = str_trim(country))

inflation_df<-inflation_df%>%
  mutate(country = str_replace(country, "Congo, Dem. Rep.", replacement = "DRC"))%>%
  mutate(country = str_extract(string = country, pattern ="[^\\(|,|*]+"))%>%
  mutate(country = str_replace(country, "Hong Kong SAR", replacement = "Hong Kong"))%>%
  mutate(country = str_trim(country))

##joining data
joined_countries<-inner_join(inflation_df, GDP_capita_df, by = "country")%>%
  inner_join(contries_df, by = "country")%>%
 
  select(country, inflation, gdp_capita, pop_2023, per_chg_pop, region, subregion)

##renaming columns and cleaning column values
clean_countries<-joined_countries%>%
  mutate(inflation = as.numeric(str_extract(inflation, "\\d+")))%>%
  mutate(gdp_capita = as.numeric(str_extract(gdp_capita, "\\d+")))%>%
  mutate(pop_2023 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(pop_2023, ",")))%>%
  mutate(pop_2023 = round(x = 0.000001*pop_2023, 3))%>%
  mutate(per_chg_pop = as.numeric(str_extract(per_chg_pop, "\\d+")))

##download clean file
write.csv(clean_countries, "/cloud/project/clean_countries.csv")

##ggplot example
clean_countries%>%group_by(region)%>%
  summarise(inf_prop = mean(inflation))%>%
ggplot(aes(x = region, y = inf_prop))+
  geom_col()
```
